description: The pie chart represents the distribution of content types in the Darija Open Dataset Version 2. There are six categories shown: Moroccan Names, Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy), Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives), Translated Sentences, Extra + Augmented Data, and Pending Translations. The largest category is Extra + Augmented Data with 45,387 entries, followed by Pending Translations with 43,000 entries. Moroccan Names has 30,000 entries, Semantic Categories has 23,108 entries, Syntactic Roles has 1,000 entries, and Translated Sentences has 1,000 entries. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest segment at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
